captions.detailed: A coastal defense embrasure cannon featuring a thick, cylindrical concrete barbette base. Atop this base sits a rectangular gun platform supporting two vertical mounting brackets. A long, smooth-bore barrel is pivoted between these brackets, allowing it to elevate vertically while the entire platform assembly rotates horizontally on the base.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated coastal defense cannon with a thick cylindrical concrete base, a square traversing gun platform with two vertical support brackets, and a cylindrical barrel mounted on a horizontal pivot. The platform should have a continuous rotational joint on the base, and the barrel should have a revolute joint to pivot vertically.
captions.factory: The model is constructed in three main parts. First, the base is created as a thick cylinder representing the concrete barbette. Second, the platform is built from a thin rectangular box with two vertical rectangular brackets extruded upwards, complete with horizontal pivot cylinders. Third, the barrel is constructed using concentric cylinders to form a hollow, stepped cannon barrel with a horizontal trunnion pin. Two joints are defined: a continuous rotational joint connecting the platform to the base, and a revolute joint connecting the barrel to the platform brackets.
